title: Normalized inverse image of the native coefficient ring
statement: Fix a prime l. For every scheme T, assume commutativity of the native abelian-sheaf ring abRing(l,T) of [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-realization-data], and let ringSheaf(l,T) be its section ring sheaf. For every scheme morphism $g:U\to V$ there is a unique isomorphism from the inverse image of ringSheaf(l,V) to ringSheaf(l,U) whose adjoint ring map sends every locally finite function s on every pro-etale test object W over V to s composed with the first projection $W\times_V U\to W$, pointwise. No finite-type, separatedness or nonemptiness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Bhatt--Scholze Section 6.8, Lemma 6.8.2 and Proposition 6.8.14; first step of lem-sf-native-compact-support-geometry, coefficient inverse image and its precomposition normalization

proof.text: Construct the direct-image ring map by precomposition of locally finite continuous functions with the first projection. Pointwise addition, multiplication, zero and one show that each component is a ring homomorphism; the pullback projection identity proves naturality. Its underlying map of set sheaves is exactly the forgotten native module coefficient map.

Apply the existing native coefficient inverse-image isomorphism in modules from lem-sf-native-adic-pullback-exact-lisse. For both modules and commutative rings, forgetting to sets commutes with the constructed inverse image by lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-pullback-forget-comparison: base change preserves finite limits, so its opposite comma categories are filtered; the forgetful functors preserve these filtered colimits and sheafification. The comparison respects the adjunction unit, hence the adjoint transpose. The module transpose is invertible, so the identical set transpose of the constructed ring map is invertible. Forgetting commutative ring sheaves reflects isomorphisms, so its ring transpose is invertible.

Take the isomorphism associated to that invertible transpose. The adjunction bijection sends its hom back to the constructed precomposition map, proving the normalization. Any other normalized isomorphism has the same adjunct, by function extensionality, subtype extensionality, and extensionality of ring and sheaf maps. Injectivity of the adjunction bijection and extensionality of isomorphisms prove uniqueness. All constructions allow empty schemes and empty test objects.

proof_origin.place: Bhatt--Scholze Lemma 4.2.12 and Section 6.8, via the existing native module coefficient isomorphism in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.Adic.UpperStar; Stacks Tag 00YV for forgetting algebraic structure. The unit-compatible comparison transports its precomposition normalization to commutative ring sheaves.

lean.statement:
theorem native_coefficient_inverse_image
    [∀ T : Scheme.{u}, IsCommMonObj (abRing l T)]
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (g : U ⟶ V) :
    ∃! c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj (ringSheaf l V) ≅
        ringSheaf l U,
      ∀ (W : V.ProEtᵒᵖ) (s : (ringSheaf l V).obj.obj W)
        (x : ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj W.unop).left),
        (((proEtaleSheafAdjunction g CommRingCat.{u + 1}).homEquiv _ _
          c.hom).hom.app W s).down.1 x =
            s.down.1 ((pullback.fst W.unop.hom g).base x)
